title: Read nested Notion blocks without missing the fine print
h1: read the blocks inside a notion page or toggle
description: Find the detail tucked inside a Notion toggle or nested list. Ask a bot to follow child blocks and tell you exactly where its reading stopped.
answer: **the line you need might sit inside a toggle.** a notion block is one piece of a page, such as a paragraph or list item. blocks can hold other blocks. give the bot a page link and ask it to follow those children. have it flag any branch it couldn't finish before you trust the answer.

review.by: lead agent, after four independent reviewers read every page against seo/facts (2026-11-20); every finding applied

what:
**reading down the page and reading into a block are different jobs.** a bot can gather the items directly under a page across batches. asking it to read recursively takes it inside items that have children. give it a parent block id if you only need one branch.

set a stopping depth when the page is large. the result can still be partial if a nested block is inaccessible or the read reaches its block budget.
uses: find the packing exception tucked beneath a costume name
bring back the small-print meal options nested under a conference menu
read the alternate ending under a scene toggle without collecting the entire script

routine.message: each thursday at 4 pm, read the wardrobe packing page in notion, including children inside the costume toggles. pull out pieces marked hand carry and put each under its costume name here. if a branch stops early, name it and call the list partial. never mark a piece packed.
routine.when: thursdays at 4 pm before tour packing
routine.needs: notion read only with access to the wardrobe page and its nested blocks
routine.output:
hand carry for sidney beck's wardrobe crew
- rain scene: spare spectacles in the inside pocket.
partial list: the ballroom costume branch reached the depth limit.

steps: share the wardrobe page with the notion connection and select **read only** in **Connected apps**.
paste the page url or the parent block id. choose the smallest branch that can answer the question.
ask for nested children and the heading above each result. compare one item with the open toggle.
watch: **a database view link won't work here.** open the actual page whose blocks you want to read.
**an empty branch and a cut-off branch mean different things.** the bot should report any depth or block limit the nested read returns.

faq.q: do i need to find the id of every block in notion?
faq.a: **start with the parent.** the bot can use the page link or the containing block's id and follow its children.

faq.q: how far into nested blocks can it read?
faq.a: **recursive reads default to ten levels and 5,000 blocks.** you can adjust those limits. access to the nested content still matters.

sources.label: dusk bot docs: files and apps

tip.text: for a sentence you can see on the open page, read it there. use the bot when its location in the nesting matters.
